slate-ink.$description: Slate Ink — Primary text, dominant borders, nav links — the workhorse dark that replaces pure black everywhere a softer edge is wanted

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Neutral form states, badge text, and quiet UI feedback where color should stay understated. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

onyx-black.$description: Onyx Black — Icon strokes, input borders, and hard-edge accents where maximum contrast is required

warm-bone.$description: Warm Bone — Secondary surface — a barely-warm cream that lifts cards off pure white without introducing visible color

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Muted helper text, secondary borders, disabled states — quieter than Slate Ink by two stops

cobalt-signal.$description: Cobalt Signal — Primary action fill — the only chromatic color in the system, reserved for CTA buttons and live action moments

stone-gray.$description: Stone Gray — Tertiary borders and inactive icon strokes — the quietest neutral, used only when Ash is still too loud

sigma-sans.$description: Navigation links, buttons, form labels, and utility micro-copy — the functional voice, compact and quiet

sigma-serif-head.$description: Display and hero headlines — a high-contrast didone-style serif at regular weight only, creating editorial authority without boldness

sigma-serif.$description: Subheadings, body paragraphs, and mid-size editorial text — the reading voice of the site, set at regular weight with generous line-height

metropolis.$description: Rare medium-weight sans for emphasized micro-labels — the only weight above 400 in the system, used sparingly

arial.$description: Arial — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

times.$description: Times — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
